name: Şube Muavin defteri
query:
SELECT
    gl.tarih as "Tarih:Date:100",
    gl.hesap as "Hesap Kodu:Link/Hesap:150",
    h.hesap_adi as "Hesap Adı::200",
    gl.aciklama as "Açıklama::250",
    gl.name as "Fiş No:Link/Muhasebe Defteri:120",
    
    gl.borc as "Borç:Currency:120",
    gl.alacak as "Alacak:Currency:120"

FROM
    `tabMuhasebe Defteri` gl

LEFT JOIN
    `tabHesap` h ON h.name = gl.hesap

WHERE
    gl.firma = %(company)s
    
    /* ŞUBE VE HESAP FİLTRESİ ZORUNLU */
    AND gl.sube = %(branch)s
    AND gl.hesap = %(account)s
    
    AND gl.tarih >= %(from_date)s
    AND gl.tarih <= %(to_date)s

ORDER BY
    gl.tarih ASC, gl.creation ASC
